visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video starts with a close-up of a female creator wearing a red baseball cap labeled 'Rich' and a white graphic T-shirt. She is standing inside a brightly lit convenience store, holding a swirl-patterned mint-green and white soft-serve ice cream cone while speaking excitedly to the lens. (2) A promotional graphic overlay appears, filling the screen with information about 'Coriander Soft Serve.' The graphic includes images of the ice cream in a cone and a cup, along with a list of seven specific store locations in Taiwan where the product is sold. (3) The creator takes a large bite of the coriander ice cream. Her eyes widen and her mouth hangs open in a expression of comedic shock. She points at the ice cream while large yellow 'Shock!!' captions appear over her face. (4) The woman is shown eating a chocolate-colored ice cream from a plastic cup, using a small wooden spoon. She looks relieved and gives a small nod, suggesting a palate cleanser or a change in flavor to something more traditional. (5) She holds up a clear plastic bottle of 'Cheers' brand coriander-flavored sparkling water. She gestures towards the bottle with a skeptical look before twisting the cap open and taking a sip, looking directly at the camera with intense focus.
